units.source_text: 學校美術課的畫帖非常無聊，老師的畫更是拙劣透頂，因此我不得不靠自己的胡亂摸索來嘗試繪畫的各種表現手法。

en.t: The art textbooks at school were terribly dull, and the teacher's paintings were utterly clumsy, so I had no choice but to grope around on my own and try various methods of expression in painting.

units.source_text: 進入中學後，我也有了一套自己的油畫畫具，

en.t: After entering middle school, I also had a complete set of my own oil painting supplies,

units.source_text: 但無論我怎樣把印象派當作範本，從其畫風中尋求技藝，

en.t: but no matter how much I took the Impressionists as my model and sought technique in their style,

units.source_text: 自己的畫卻總是像彩色印花紙工藝一樣呆滯得不成體統。

en.t: my own paintings always turned out as flat and lifeless as colored paper craft, hopelessly unworthy of the name.

units.source_text: 不過，竹一的一句話卻讓我茅塞頓開，意識到自己以前對繪畫的認識都是錯誤的。

en.t: However, one remark from Takeichi opened my eyes, and I realized that everything I had thought about painting until then had been wrong.

units.source_text: 感受美麗的事物，並如實地表現出它們的美麗，這種想法是多麼的幼稚和愚蠢。

en.t: How childish and foolish it was to think that one should feel beautiful things and then represent their beauty just as it was.
